description: This file contains functions for managing plugin runtime dependencies in a Node.js project, including reading/writing package.json files, handling dependency installation, verifying versions, and staging runtime dependencies for bundled plugins.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from the specified path.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a value as JSON and writes it to a file.

methods.name: removePathIfExists
methods.description: Removes the specified directory or file if it exists.

methods.name: makeTempDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory with a specified prefix.

methods.name: sanitizeTempPrefixSegment
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be safe as prefix segment for temporary directory names.

methods.name: replaceDir
methods.description: Replaces a target directory with a source directory, handling cross-device moves.

methods.name: dependencyNodeModulesPath
methods.description: Constructs a path to a dependency inside node_modules.

methods.name: readInstalledDependencyVersion
methods.description: Reads the installed version of a dependency from node_modules.

methods.name: dependencyVersionSatisfied
methods.description: Checks if an installed dependency version satisfies a specified semver range.

methods.name: collectInstalledRuntimeClosure
methods.description: Collects all dependencies in the closure satisfying version constraints.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDirs
methods.description: Lists directories of bundled plugins in the project.

methods.name: hasRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Checks if a package.json has dependencies or optionalDependencies.

methods.name: shouldStageRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Determines if runtime dependencies should be staged based on package.json config.

methods.name: sanitizeBundledManifestForRuntimeInstall
methods.description: Sanitizes peerDependencies, peerDependenciesMeta, and devDependencies related to openclaw.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeDepsStampPath
methods.description: Resolves the path to the runtime dependencies stamp file.

methods.name: createRuntimeDepsFingerprint
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash fingerprint of the package.json.

methods.name: readRuntimeDepsStamp
methods.description: Reads the runtime dependencies stamp JSON file if it exists.

methods.name: stageInstalledRootRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Stages runtime dependencies by copying node_modules to a temporary location and replacing the existing one.

methods.name: installPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Installs runtime dependencies for a plugin, either from cache or by invoking npm.

methods.name: installPluginRuntimeDepsWithRetries
methods.description: Retries installation attempts for plugin runtime dependencies.

methods.name: stageBundledPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Main exported function that stages runtime dependencies for all bundled plugins based on configuration.
